responsibility: Provides the Sphinx build configuration for the `gcc/doc/libgdiagnostics` documentation set. This file belongs to GCC's documentation infrastructure rather than the compiler proper: it declares the `libgdiagnostics` project metadata, selects the basic HTML output theme and static/template paths, and defines which generated or platform-specific files to exclude when Sphinx builds the manual, thereby controlling how the libgdiagnostics docs are rendered into HTML.
